mode.title: Translation mode
mode.description: Manual responds only to commands. Automatic translates eligible normal chat. Both enables both paths.

provider.title: Translation provider
provider.description: Google web supports automatic source detection but is an undocumented no-key endpoint. MyMemory is documented but requires a fixed source language.

sourceLanguage.title: Source language
sourceLanguage.description: Use auto with Google web, or an explicit code such as es with MyMemory.

targetLanguage.title: Default output language
targetLanguage.description: Used by !translate text and automatic mode. Example: en.

genericCommandName.title: Manual command name
genericCommandName.description: With the defaults, !translate buenos dias translates into English. No Streamer.bot command object is required.

languageCommands.title: Target-language shortcuts
languageCommands.description: One code per line. es enables !es hello. These codes also enable the backward-compatible !translate es hello format.

tutorialMessage.title: Manual help message
tutorialMessage.default: Usage: !translate text, !translate {targetLanguage} text, or !{targetLanguage} text. On Twitch, you can also reply with !{targetLanguage}.

errorMessage.title: Manual provider failure message
errorMessage.default: Translation is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

automaticAllowedNames.title: Automatically translate these viewer names or IDs
automaticAllowedNames.description: Recommended: start with a small allowlist. One exact platform name or stable ID per line.

automaticIgnoredNames.title: Never automatically translate these names or IDs
automaticIgnoredNames.description: Preloaded with common service bots; add or remove exact login names as needed.

detectLanguageLocally.title: Skip English messages without calling the translator
detectLanguageLocally.description: When translating into English with automatic source detection, StreamBridge checks each message on your PC first and only sends messages that look like another language. Translations that come back unchanged are never posted.

voiceSubscriptionsEnabled.title: Viewers can follow along in chat (!translateme)
voiceSubscriptionsEnabled.description: A viewer types !translateme es. What you say is collected for the batch window and posted as one translated message in that viewer's chat, until it expires or they type !translateme off.

voiceOnDemandEnabled.title: Viewers can ask what you just said (!whatdidyousay)
voiceOnDemandEnabled.description: Translates the last few seconds of your speech once, into the viewer's chat.

voiceCaptionsEnabled.title: Viewers can turn on translated captions on screen (!captions)
voiceCaptionsEnabled.description: Shows your speech translated on the Translate overlay for everyone. Add the overlay as a browser source.

voiceBilingualEnabled.title: Bilingual captions: your words with a translation underneath
voiceBilingualEnabled.description: Shows what you say on the Translate overlay for everyone, the whole time it is on: your own words on the first line and the translation under it. Needs Live Captions.

voiceBilingualLanguages.title: Bilingual captions: translate into
voiceBilingualLanguages.description: One or two language codes, for example es or ja. Each gets its own line.

voiceBilingualShowOriginal.title: Bilingual captions: show your own words on top
voiceBilingualShowOriginal.description: Turn off to show only the translation.

voiceBilingualBatchSeconds.title: Bilingual captions: update every (seconds)
voiceBilingualBatchSeconds.description: What you say in this window becomes one caption, so the translator is not called for every few words.

voiceLanguages.title: Languages viewers can pick
voiceLanguages.description: Language codes, for example es, fr, ja, zh-cn, ko, id, de, is. Viewers can type the code or the language name.

voiceBatchSeconds.title: Chat batch window (seconds)
voiceBatchSeconds.description: Everything you say in this window becomes one chat message per language.

voiceSubscribedMessage.title: Follow-along started message
voiceSubscribedMessage.default: {viewer}, I will translate the streamer into {language} here for {minutes} minutes. Type !{command} off to stop.

voiceLanguagesMessage.title: Pick-a-language message
voiceLanguagesMessage.description: Shown when no or an unknown language is given. Placeholders: {viewer}, {languages}.

voiceFullMessage.title: Too many languages message
voiceFullMessage.default: {viewer}, {maximum} languages are already being translated ({active}). Try one of those.

voiceNothingMessage.title: Nothing said message
voiceNothingMessage.default: {viewer}, the streamer has not said anything in the last {seconds} seconds.

voiceCaptionsOnMessage.title: Captions on message
voiceCaptionsOnMessage.default: On-screen {language} captions are on for {minutes} minutes.

voicePushToTalkEnabled.title: Stream Deck "Translate me" button
voicePushToTalkEnabled.description: Press the THSV Addon - Translate - Push to Talk action once to start, talk, then press it again. Everything you said is translated and posted once per language to the chats below.

voicePushToTalkLanguages.title: Button translates into
voicePushToTalkLanguages.description: Language codes, for example es, fr, ja.

voicePushToTalkOutput.title: Button sends to
voicePushToTalkOutput.description: Chat, on-screen captions (the Translate overlay) or both. Each Stream Deck button can override this with its pushToTalkOutput argument.

voicePushToTalkSilenceSeconds.title: Finish when I pause for (seconds)
voicePushToTalkSilenceSeconds.description: After you start speaking, a pause this long sends the translation without a second press. 0 waits for the second press.

showAutomaticErrors.title: Post automatic provider failures in chat
